scope.evidence: Comparison of the supplied AI-generated Q2 workbook and completed Q2 workbook.
scope.limits: Completed workbook is treated as the answer key, not independently validated. This is not a complete cell-by-cell formula audit. Possible causes are hypotheses based on observed symptoms.

conclusion.finding: An optimized prompt alone is not a sufficient control for reliable valuation-workbook production.
conclusion.safe_reliance: Use AI heavily for interpretation, semantic mapping, exception analysis, candidate lineage, and drafting. Do not use AI alone for authoritative source selection, calculation execution, formula-network integrity, reconciliation, valuation-policy approval, or final sign-off.

weaknesses.ai: Selected ~12.3608x and said it was carried from Q1.
weaknesses.risk: Misstates EV and all downstream values.
possible_causes: No blocking reconciliation to approved comparables
Wrong LTM window or period mapping

Attribution lines were predominantly zero and did not explain value movement.

weaknesses.risk: Plausible-looking but materially wrong return metrics.
supplements: Tie-out to proceeds and invested capital

weaknesses.ai: Key ownership, invested capital, carrying value, MOIC, IRR, and Q2 fields blank.
weaknesses.answer_key: LP report populated from core outputs.

weaknesses.ai: Created Q2 sheets without fully reconnecting the integrated model.
weaknesses.answer_key: Linked financials, adjustments, comps, valuation, cap table, IRR, attribution, and LP report.
weaknesses.risk: Correct local values coexist with stale downstream logic.

weaknesses.ai: Disclosed unresolved items yet still carried assumptions into outputs.
weaknesses.risk: Review labels do not stop unsupported values from flowing.

lean_on_ai_for: Proposed workbook changes after logic is known

options.name: AI copilot plus deterministic valuation engine
options.structure: AI interprets/maps/explains; deterministic services calculate, reconcile, trace, and write; humans approve material exceptions.
options.fit: Best overall response to the observed failures.

options.name: Template-preserving AI-assisted roll-forward
options.structure: Deterministically preserve and roll the approved prior workbook; AI maps new inputs and flags structural changes.
options.strength: Fastest lower-risk MVP and preserves known logic.
options.tradeoff: Can inherit legacy defects and needs special handling for structural changes.

options.name: Dual-path build plus gold-key testbench
options.structure: Separate extraction/reference path and forward-build path; deterministic testbench compares anchors, formulas, outputs, and coverage.
options.strength: Measures whether logic was learned and supports regression testing.
options.tradeoff: More workflow complexity; independence must be protected.
options.fit: Best assurance layer, not necessarily the production builder itself.

options.name: Broad AI generation with strict release gates
options.structure: AI generates most content, but validators independently recompute critical metrics and block release.
options.tradeoff: Detects failures but may not repair them; highest residual risk.
options.fit: Useful interim control, weakest long-term design.

workflow: Fingerprint sources and approved prior workbook
AI maps evidence into schema with citations/confidence
Deterministic engines calculate all critical outputs
Human reviews material exceptions and signs off
recommendation.bottom_line: AI should lead interpretation, while deterministic calculation, provenance, validation, and human approval form the control system.
